title: Article 389 — Provision as to Bills pending in provisional Parliament / Legislatures (Omitted)

content.overview: Article 389 dealt with Bills pending in the provisional Parliament or provisional State Legislatures. Omitted by the Constitution (Seventh Amendment) Act, 1956 (w.e.f. 1-11-1956). Spent transitional provision.
content.glance: Art 389 omitted by 7th Amendment 1956 (w.e.f. 1-11-1956). Pending Bills transitional — spent.
content.study: Part of the 379–391 transitional block. Omitted by 7th Amendment, 1956 (w.e.f. 1-11-1956).

questionsAndAnswers.question: Status of Article 389?
questionsAndAnswers.answer: Omitted by the 7th Amendment, 1956 (w.e.f. 1-11-1956). Spent transitional provision.
